author: Teeare
quote: 1 for the graphics, O for everything else. 13 years and a billion dollar budget and Jason mumbles to the point of incomprehension. Story is weak, no one wanted a love story gta. It’s ridiculous. If they added it as an online dlc at some point, that would be understandable. But to be the main story **** game is missing the whole point of what gta actually is. Be better, Rockstar.
